set.body:
User supplied Bone et al. bhy014.pdf (doi:10.1093/cercor/bhy014). Completed unaligned 14-way baseline: 347/3,017 eyes4s cosine and 343/3,017 eyesim; chance 1/14.

Next bounded slice: whole-trial subject-specific Procrustes extension with held-out retrieval excluded from all fitting and preprocessing. Verify the map-feature-space formulation, low-rank/null-space convention and an independent oracle before assigning parity. Keep this distinct from exact 29-window paper replication, which needs fixation-onset/boundary provenance, angular calibration and the authoritative 17-person cohort (current retain-all cohort: 18).

The paper establishes 757 × 522 images centered on 1024 × 768, with encoding runs interleaved at positions 1, 4 and 7. Record a chronological encoding-only sensitivity separately. Preserve all source flags. Do not infer fixation onsets or treat eyesim as an unquestioned reference.

Evidence: ignored fixtures/private/pic_sequences/runs/20261013-decoding/REPORT.md and paper-evidence.json. No raw-data publication to GitHub.
